title: Add adaptive init-phase registry and hermetic-hook mode for private helm charts
author: Linnea Morgan
body:
Motivation: Private deployments must support highly constrained environments (air-gapped, restricted egress) and customer-specific initialization sequences. Existing init-hook helpers were brittle for multi-tenant upgrades and did not provide a composable registry for ordering complex init steps. This PR introduces two complementary changes: (1) an 'init-phase registry' values surface that lets operators declare named phases and assign hooks/templates to them with explicit ordering and dependency hints, and (2) a 'hermeticHookMode' for init jobs which enforces hermetic execution (no network, configurable ephemeral volume) for airgapped/on-prem installations.

Summary of changes: Adds a new values schema block .initRegistry which is a list of named phases and entries. Each entry can reference a chart template or an external job bundle (OCI artifact) and include timeout/retry policies. Introduces templating helpers to render registry entries as sequenced Kubernetes Jobs or Jobs-with-ephemeral-pod (hermetic). Adds a small migration shim that converts legacy init annotations (helm.sh/legacy-init) into registry entries on upgrade. Adds unit and integration tests for: ordered init execution, hermetic mode enforcement (networkPolicy stub + emptyEnv), and upgrade idempotency.

Key values shape (example): values initRegistry format: {"phases": [{"name":"pre-migrate","entries":[{"id":"check-db","type":"template","template":"init/check-db.yaml","timeout":"5m"},{"id":"download-artifact","type":"oci","ociRef":"oci://registry.company.local/init/nginx-bundle:1.2","hermetic":true}]},{"name":"migrate","entries":[{"id":"db-migrate","type":"template","template":"init/db-migrate.yaml","timeout":"15m"}]}], "hermeticHookMode": {"default":false, "enforceNetworkPolicy":true, "ephemeralVolumeSize":"50Mi"}}. The schema is validated in charts/private/values.schema.json and documented in charts/private/README-init-registry.md.

Templates and helpers added: charts/private/templates/_init_registry_helpers.tpl - helper functions to render phase loops and convert OCI bundles into Jobs; charts/private/templates/hermetic-hook-job.yaml - Job spec that strips env/network and mounts ephemeral volume; charts/private/templates/init-registry-configmap.yaml - serialized registry for debugging; scripts/migrate-legacy-init.sh - shim to migrate legacy annotations during helm upgrade.

Backward compatibility: Default behavior is unchanged if .initRegistry is not specified. The migration shim only runs when helm detects the legacy annotation key and will log a clear message to the release notes. Default hermeticHookMode is false; enabling it requires explicit opt-in per-phase or top-level.

Testing: Local unit tests added under charts/private/tests/unit/init_registry_test.go (mock templating assertions); kind-based integration tests under charts/private/tests/integration/validate_hermetic.sh which run on an isolated cluster with a network-policy controller. CI: added a new workflow helm-init-registry-check that renders templates with several sample values and runs the integration script in a Kind job.

Operational notes and rollout: Recommend a staged rollout with canary namespace: 1) install with .initRegistry enabled in non-prod canary and set hermeticHookMode.default=false, 2) run migration shim and verify init-configmap is created, 3) enable hermeticHookMode.default=true for airgapped clusters only. Rollback: registry entries are idempotent; the migration shim writes a reversible annotation (.initRegistry.migrated=true).

Risks and mitigations: OCI bundle resolution requires cluster-local registries for airgapped installs; documented in README and validated by integration tests. Hermetic mode may require cluster policies (PodSecurity, SCC) adjustments; warnings and guidance added to README.

Related: Addresses ENG-1879 (improve private init sequencing) and ENG-1980 (support airgapped init execution). Also surfaces a support playbook SUP-4012 for on-call to follow if init jobs fail in hermetic mode.
commits: a1f3b9c: introduce initRegistry schema and README
c9e7f34: migration shim and helper script for legacy annotations
d13a9ab: integration tests and CI workflow helm-init-registry-check
e7b2c5d: small tidyups, docs and examples
review_comments: Miguel Santos: Please add a short note in the upgrade docs about RBAC requirements for the migration shim (will the helm operator need extra perms?).
Linnea Morgan: Added a note in README and limited migration shim to only create ConfigMaps and annotations; no extra cluster roles required. See scripts/migrate-legacy-init.sh.
Rina Kapoor: Can we default hermeticHookMode.enforceNetworkPolicy=false for clusters without a network policy controller?
Linnea Morgan: Yes — enforceNetworkPolicy defaults to true but we added hermeticHookMode.allowIfNoPolicy=true to fall back and emit a warning.
release_notes: Added initRegistry for ordered and composable init phases and hermeticHookMode to support airgapped/on-prem initializers. Migration shim converts legacy init annotations. Backwards compatible by default.
